signals.title: Recognizable daily activity rhythm
signals.observation: 80% of timestamped activity falls inside 11:00–15:00 UTC. Evenly spread activity would put about 17% in any 4-hour window.
signals.limitation: This does not reveal a location or time zone. Bots, schedulers and shared wallets produce rhythms too. It does make the activity pattern comparable across wallets.
signals.recommendation: Patterns in timing can link wallets that share an owner. Avoid operating several wallets in the same short sessions.

signals.title: Trading history is public
signals.observation: 29 swaps across 4 tokens, mostly via jupiter. Entry sizes, timing and token choices are visible to anyone.
signals.limitation: Swap amounts are as reported by the venue. Profit and loss cannot be determined from a partial window.
signals.recommendation: Trade from a dedicated address funded through a path that is not tied to your main wallet.

signals.title: First funding source is visible
signals.observation: 25.0000 SOL arrived from 5XuR…rh9K on 2026-07-18, the earliest inbound SOL in the wallet history.
signals.limitation: Funding links two addresses but does not show who controls the funder.
signals.recommendation: The address that funds a new wallet is often the strongest link back to its owner. Fund new wallets from a source you are comfortable being associated with.

signals.title: Holdings are publicly readable
signals.observation: Anyone can read this address's balance: 42.3710 SOL, 4 fungible tokens and 2 NFTs, with roughly $8,246 of provider-priced value.
signals.limitation: A snapshot, not a history. USD values come from the provider and are missing for unpriced tokens. Holdings in other wallets controlled by the same person are not visible here.
signals.recommendation: Keep long-term holdings in an address you never use for payments, mints or social activity, so a single payment does not reveal your full balance.

signals.title: Interaction with labeled entity: Demo Exchange (fictional)
signals.observation: 7 transactions with an address publicly labeled "Demo Exchange (fictional)" (Centralized Exchange). Exchanges hold off-chain account records that can be matched to deposit and withdrawal transactions.
signals.limitation: The label describes the counterparty, not this wallet. Labels are provider assertions and may be incomplete or out of date.
signals.recommendation: Withdraw from exchanges to an intermediate address rather than directly to wallets you want kept separate.

signals.title: Repeated 1.500 SOL payment
signals.observation: 11 outbound transfers of 1.500 SOL to HVqm…YwrN. Fixed amounts on a repeating basis read like a subscription, salary or scheduled transfer.
signals.limitation: Amounts are matched to 0.001 SOL. A matching amount does not prove the payments share a purpose.
signals.recommendation: Vary amounts and the sending address for recurring payments you do not want to fingerprint this wallet.
